Core Capabilities
 

One store. Clear numbers. Automations that work.

 

Zyrn is not “just a website.” It is the operating system for your sales.

 
 
 
 
  
 
 Branded Storefront 
 
 Your logo, colors, and content on a mobile-ready store — premium from day one, not a temporary link in bio. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Sell Anything 
 
 Physical products, digital downloads, subscriptions, bookings, bundles, and multi-currency or multi-language storefronts. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Notified on the Spot 
 
 Order placed → payment confirmed → shipped → delivered → return opened. Customers stay informed without chasing you. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Checkout & Payments 
 
 Smooth cart and checkout with cards, wallets, COD, bank transfer, and major gateways — take the money, confirm, move on. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Marketing & Growth 
 
 Coupons, catalog rules, email campaigns, SEO, social share, and newsletter tools — offers, timing, and follow-through. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Live Statistics 
 
 Sales, bestsellers, customers, carts, promotions, inventory — open the numbers and decide what to do next. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Automations 
 
 Order emails, status alerts, promotion rules, stock signals, and extendable flows like cart recovery and WhatsApp updates. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Inventory & Team Control 
 
 Stock that updates with sales, import/export, returns/RMA, and staff roles so your team works from one system.

Replace the paper trail

Stay with the customer
 
Status updates go out the moment something changes — payment, shipment, delivery, return. No “let me check.”

Own the relationship

Grow into more models

Morning

FAQ

 
 
  I already sell on Instagram. Why do I need Zyrn?     
 Instagram is discovery. Zyrn is checkout, stock, notifications, and ownership of the customer relationship — so orders stop living in DMs. 
 
 
  Can’t I just use a form?     
 Forms take requests. Zyrn takes payment, tracks inventory, and updates the customer automatically when something changes. 
 
 
  I’m too small for software. Is this for me?     
 That is exactly when chaos starts. Zyrn keeps a small business clean before the mess becomes expensive — launch lean, add subscriptions, digital, and automations later. 
 
 
  Can I sell digital products or subscriptions?     
 Yes. Instant delivery for downloads and licenses, plus subscription and membership flows for boxes, plans, and recurring revenue. 
 
 
  Will customers know what is happening with their order?     
 Yes. Notified on the spot — order, payment, shipping, and returns — so you are not typing the same update fifty times a day. 
 
 
  How do I know what to sell next?     
 Statistics. Bestsellers. Customer behavior. Cart and promotion views. No guessing — open the dashboard and decide.
